tagline: PhotoCraft on a Selkies web desktop: a layered photo editor in the browser that opens PSD, Krita and Affinity files.
description: PhotoCraft, a layered photo editor that opens PSD, Krita and Affinity files, on a Selkies web desktop. It runs in your browser without a VNC client or a local install, on amd64 and arm64.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: PhotoCraft
